images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable bark albedo/base-color texture for an original 3D chicken tree-village game. Produce ONLY a flat square 2D texture, edge to edge, no tree silhouette, no scene, no props, no text. Beautiful hand-painted old oak bark, warm weathered gray-brown and muted honey-taupe wood, with a few cool gray recessed fissures, subtle mossy olive traces very sparsely. Broad irregular vertically flowing elongated bark ribbons, tapering furrows, split overlapping flakes with small chipped edges, occasional restrained elongated knot scars; combine large readable painterly forms and fine tactile brush grain. Organic asymmetric rhythm and graceful slightly twisting longitudinal grain, not uniform stripes, not topographic contour rings, not cracked desert mud, not photorealistic photographic noise. Game-production base color: balanced midtones, largely neutral diffuse illumination, no cast shadows, no baked sunlight highlights or directional lighting, no black crevices or glossy shine; the 3D model will supply sculpted relief and lighting. Seamlessly tile left/right and top/bottom. Cohesive polished storybook woodland material, restrained contrast, natural depth from hue variation. Square 1536x1536 preferred.
